title: FoundPDE: A generative foundation model for data-driven symbolic discovery of partial differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.26963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from observed data is a central inverse problem in computational science and engineering: the goal is not only to predict trajectories, but to identify interpretable symbolic laws that can be analyzed and reused. Existing PDE discovery methods often depend on hand-designed libraries, accurate numerical derivatives, or per-equation symbolic search, making them fragile under sparse observations, noisy data, broad equation families, and unseen symbolic compositions. Here, we introduce FoundPDE, a pretrained data-to-symbol foundation model for PDE discovery. FoundPDE maps discretized spatio-temporal trajectories to symbolic equations with a transformer, uses Fourier and first-order spatial-derivative augmentation to expose complementary trajectory information, refines numerical coefficients, and supports downstream extension with improved generalization through few-shot fine-tunin

translated_title: FoundPDE：用于数据驱动的偏微分方程符号发现的生成式基础模型
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中发现控制偏微分方程（PDE）是计算科学与工程中的核心逆问题：其目标不仅是预测轨迹，而是识别出可分析、可复用的可解释符号规律。现有的偏微分方程发现方法通常依赖手工设计的函数库、精确的数值导数或针对单个方程的符号搜索，这使它们在稀疏观测、噪声数据、广泛的方程族以及未见过的符号组合等情况下表现脆弱。本文提出了FoundPDE，一个用于偏微分方程发现的预训练数据到符号基础模型。FoundPDE使用Transformer将离散化的时空轨迹映射为符号方程，利用傅里叶变换和一阶空间导数增强来揭示互补的轨迹信息，并对数值系数进行精化，同时通过少样本微调支持下游扩展并提升泛化能力。
tldr: 提出FoundPDE——首个预训练的数据到符号生成式基础模型，利用Transformer将离散时空轨迹直接映射为符号偏微分方程，并通过傅里叶与一阶空间导数增强及少样本微调，实现了在噪声、稀疏数据下对广泛方程族的鲁棒发现与良好泛化。
en_tdlr: FoundPDE is a pretrained data-to-symbol generative foundation model that uses a transformer to map discretized spatio-temporal trajectories directly to symbolic PDEs, leveraging Fourier and first-order spatial-derivative augmentation with few-shot fine-tuning for robust and generalizable equation discovery.
